Biogeographic Distribution of Flora Species (WCVP / WGSRPD Level 3)

Source: R/anp_especies_distr.R
anp_especies_distr.Rd

A dataset containing the global biogeographic distribution of flora species registered in Peru's Protected Natural Areas (ANP), retrieved using the wcvpmatch package and the World Checklist of Vascular Plants (WCVP) database. Categorized according to the World Geographic Scheme for Recording Plant Distributions (WGSRPD) Level 3 standard.

Usage

anp_especies_distr

Format

A tibble with 183,558 rows and 9 variables:

submitted_name

Character. Binomial scientific name of the species as registered in bioANP.

matched_taxon

Character. Standardized scientific name matched against WCVP.

match_distance

Numeric. String distance of the taxonomic match (0 for exact match).

continent

Character. Continent name corresponding to WGSRPD Level 1.

region

Character. Region name corresponding to WGSRPD Level 2.

area_code_l3

Character. Standardized 3-letter WGSRPD Level 3 geographic area code (e.g., "BZN", "CLM", "PER").

area

Character. Full name of the WGSRPD Level 3 botanical area (e.g., "Peru", "Colombia", "Brazil North").

occurrence_type

Character. Type of species occurrence in the area ("native", "introduced", "location_doubtful", "extinct").

distribution_status

Character. Status of the distribution record in WCVP.

Source

Data retrieved from WCVP using wcvpmatch for flora species in Peru's bioANP platform.

Details

Information was generated using wcvpmatch::wcvp_distribution() from the wcvpmatch package. The World Geographic Scheme for Recording Plant Distributions (WGSRPD) is a standard developed by Biodiversity Information Standards (TDWG).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Load dataset
data(anp_especies_distr)

# View top geographic areas with native species from Peruvian ANPs
library(dplyr)
anp_especies_distr %>%
  filter(occurrence_type == "native") %>%
  count(area, sort = TRUE)
} # }
